name: doc-keeper
description: Keep changelogs and architecture decision records aligned with completed work, release preparation, and explicit decisions through evidence-based, infrastructure-aware procedures.

interface.longDescription: DocKeeper gives Codex an evidence-first closeout, release-preflight, and maintenance process for changelogs and architecture decision records. It detects existing infrastructure, preserves document ownership, and avoids invented history or unauthorized remote actions.
defaultPrompt: Use DocKeeper to maintain changelogs and ADRs, close out notable changes, or prepare release history.
